title: Fixed scalar Cech functors and right external coefficient Cech models
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and families $U_i\subset X$, $V_j\subset Y$. Using scalar restriction [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], define the coefficient functor $C_U(F)=\check C(U,\operatorname{scalarSheaf}_f F)$. Define $A(G)$ to be the zero extension to integer degrees of the tensor total $C_U(F)\otimes_k C_V(G)$. Define $B(G)$ to be the zero extension of the scalar Cech complex on the product cover $W_{ij}=\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V_j$, with coefficient $\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. These are functors; they preserve zero morphisms. All objects and maps are given by existing Cech, tensor, pullback and extension constructions, with no existence-selected data.
